question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
WITH pop_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    country,
    year_2017 AS pop_2017,
    year_2018 AS pop_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(year_2018 - year_2017, year_2017) * 100 AS pop_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL 
    AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL 
    AND year_2017 > 0
),
health_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    value AS health_2017,
    LEAD(value) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code ORDER BY year) AS health_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD'
    AND year IN (2017, 2018)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop_data p
JOIN health_data h ON p.country_code = h.country_code
WHERE p.pop_growth_pct > 1
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h.health_2018 - h.health_2017, h.health_2017) * 100 > 1
  AND h.health_2017 IS NOT NULL
  AND h.health_2018 IS NOT NULL
  AND p.country_code NOT IN (
    'AFE', 'AFW', 'ARB', 'CEB', 'CSS', 'EAR', 'ECA', 'EMU', 'HIC', 'HPC', 
    'LAC', 'LCN', 'LIC', 'LMC', 'LMY', 'MEA', 'MIC', 'NAC', 'OED', 
    'SAS', 'SST', 'TEA', 'TEC', 'TSS', 'WLD', 'IBT', 'INX', 'IDB', 'PSS',
    'IBD', 'IDA', 'IDX'
  )
